exposure: Surgical treatment for adnexal torsion during pregnancy
surgical treatment for adnexal torsion (AT) during pregnancy
cohort: Parturients who underwent surgery for suspected adnexal torsion during pregnancy (n=85) compared to matched controls with uneventful pregnancies
finding: Adnexal detorsion with or without additional surgical procedures during pregnancy did not affect the gestational age at delivery or increase fetal or maternal complication rates.
mod_finding: This study investigated surgical treatment for adnexal torsion during pregnancy but did not focus on comparing outcomes based on mode of delivery.
